admin.enabled_help: Each new member is welcomed once, when they are actually in: when they confirm their email address, or when Gatehouse approves them. Existing members are never messaged.
admin.channel_help: A private message uses Parley if it is installed, otherwise Flarum's own private messages.
admin.sender_help: The username the private message comes from, for example your own or a staff account. Leave it empty to use the first admin.
admin.subject: Email subject
admin.subject_help: For the email. You can use {username}, {display_name}, {forum} and {url}.
admin.body_help: Used for both the private message and the email. You can use {username}, {display_name}, {forum} and {url}. Leave it empty for the standard welcome.

test.help: Sends the welcome to you, using the saved settings. Save first.
test.status_sent: sent: check your messages and inbox.
test.status_off: not used by the current setting.
test.status_failed: failed. The forum's log has the reason.
test.status_no_messages: nothing to send it with: enable Parley or Flarum's private messages.
test.status_no_sender: skipped: you are the sender, and nobody can message themselves. Try it from another admin account, or set a different sender.
